title: HazeGuard GNSS Observation
description: A GNSS spoofing or jamming observation. The complete serialized JSON observation payload must not exceed 64 KB; payload-size enforcement is performed by the backend.

node_id.description: Non-empty identifier of the GNSS detection node that produced the observation.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time when the observation was made. It must include an explicit timezone, expressed as Z or a numeric UTC offset.

signal_type.description: Classification of the detected GNSS signal event.

confidence.description: Detector confidence on a 1 to 10 scale, inclusive. Decimal values are allowed. This value is not a probability or threat-severity rating.

coordinates.description: Observation location as WGS84 decimal-degree coordinates.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90 inclusive.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180 inclusive.

metadata.description: Additional observation metadata. Values may use nested JSON objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and null.
